references.title: Commerce Expands 50% Section 232 Tariffs to Steel-Based Household Appliances
2026 Appliance Price Increases: How to Buy Smart
The Most Reliable Appliance Brands for 2026
Appliance Prices Jumped 4.3% in May as Tariff Costs Hit Showroom Floors
Initially Delayed, the Pass-Through of Tariffs to Consumer Prices Has Arrived
GE Appliances Announces Historic $3 Billion Investment to Expand U.S. Manufacturing
DOE Finalizes Efficiency Standards for Residential Refrigerators and Freezers
Hisense HRM260N6TSE Review: An Excellent Value French-Door Refrigerator
The 5 Best French Door Refrigerators of 2026

en.commentary:
A refrigerator bought in 2026 is a tariff decision as much as a kitchen decision. Commerce pulled combined refrigerator-freezers under HTSUS 8418.10.00 into the Section 232 derivative list on June 23, 2025, and this April the government moved to a flat 25% rate applied to the full customs value of an imported appliance. Six manufacturers repriced between June 1 and August 1: ASKO 10%, GE and Cafe 7% to 11%, LG 6%, KitchenAid 3.5% to 6.5%, Whirlpool roughly 4% on top of the 10% it already took in April, Bosch and Thermador 8% to 12%. Major appliance prices climbed 4.3% in May alone and 12.2% year over year through July. Every sticker on this page already carries that.

That is why the GE Profile PVD28BYNFS takes first place. It is 27.9 cubic feet selling at $2,799 in the field against a $4,399 list, and GE Appliances is spending $3 billion to move refrigerator production out of China into its Alabama plant while Louisville absorbs more work. A machine assembled inside the tariff wall has less room to move when the next proclamation lands.

The strongest counter-argument runs through LG. Yale Appliance logged 33,190 first-year service calls and LG came out at 5.5%, the lowest nameplate in the set. The LF24Z6530S delivers 23.7 cubic feet at counter depth with hinges that let both doors open flat against a tight cabinet, and it clears at $1,699 against a $3,899 list. It ships from overseas, so I read that price as a window that closes.

Two things decide reliability here. French door refrigerators are among the most serviced products Yale tracks, and the ice maker is the reason: ice travels through the warm fresh-food section, which produces leaks, frozen lines and clogged dispensers. Models carrying Wi-Fi, touchscreens and app integration run 10% to 20% higher service rates than the plain models sitting beside them from the same brand. I score that directly, which is where the Samsung Bespoke and its Family Hub+ screen land at tenth on a list where the hardware itself is the most capable here.

One date worth holding onto: the DOE rule finalized December 29, 2023 cuts refrigerator energy use about 11%, with compliance due January 31, 2029 or 2030 depending on configuration. Whatever you buy this year runs on today's numbers for the whole 12 to 15 years you own it.

highlights.title: GE Profile wins because its factory sits inside the tariff wall
highlights.body: GE Appliances announced a $3 billion U.S. manufacturing expansion in August 2025 that moves six refrigerator models out of China into its Alabama plant, adds 800 jobs at the Louisville headquarters complex, and spreads work across Kentucky, Georgia, Alabama, Tennessee and South Carolina. That is the variable I weight hardest right now. The PVD28BYNFS pairs that footing with 27.9 cubic feet, TwinChill dual evaporators keeping fresh-food humidity separate from the freezer, a door-in-door panel with a rotating bin for wine bottles, and hands-free AutoFill. It lists at $4,399 and moves at $2,799, which works out to about $100 per cubic foot on a machine whose supply chain is being deliberately pulled onshore.

highlights.title: LG's 5.5% first-year service rate is the single most useful number in this category
highlights.body: Yale Appliance publishes first-year service rates from 33,190 calls, and LG's 5.5% is the lowest nameplate in the data, with GE and GE Profile close behind at 8% to 9.2%. Numbers drawn from actual repair dispatches beat survey sentiment every time, because a technician either drove out or did not. LG's linear compressor, the part people worry about, failed about 1.1% within five years across more than 160,000 tracked calls. That reliability record is what makes the $1,699 street price on a 23.7 cubic foot counter-depth machine the strongest single value on this page.

highlights.title: The ice maker is where French door refrigerators break, and I score it separately for that reason
highlights.body: French door models sit among the most serviced products Yale tracks, and the mechanism is structural: ice gets manufactured and stored inside the warm fresh-food cabinet, so the fill line, the mold heater and the dispenser chute all live in a place where melt water has somewhere to go. Leaks, frozen fill tubes and clogged chutes follow. Industry repair data puts French door failure rates at roughly twice those of top-freezer units, and models with a water dispenser average 9 to 12 years of life. Every model here gets its own ice and water score, and the Whirlpool WRF555SDFZ ranks modestly on that line while it earns its place on tariff exposure instead.

highlights.title: Hisense at $1,799 delivers more usable capacity per dollar than anything else here
highlights.body: The HRM260N6TSE carries 25.6 cubic feet in a four-door layout with a VersaTemp drawer covering wine through deep freeze, 360 degree LED lighting and ConnectLife app control, at a $1,799 introductory price against a $2,899 MSRP. Independent lab testing rated its temperature stability as unusually strong for the price band, which is exactly where cheap refrigerators normally give ground. The tradeoff is a China-built chassis absorbing the full 25% rate, plus a thinner U.S. service network, and that is what holds it at sixth rather than higher.

highlights.title: Sub-Zero's $13,249 buys a twelve-year sealed system warranty and a Wisconsin build
highlights.body: The CL4250SD runs two compressors on separate circuits so the freezer never dries out the fresh-food side, cycles an air purification cartridge that scrubs ethylene every 20 minutes, and backs the sealed system for 12 years. Sub-Zero builds in Wisconsin and Arizona with one of the highest domestic content shares in the industry, which is why it scores 9.5 on tariff exposure while imported luxury competitors sit near 6. At 24 cubic feet inside 42 inches of wall it uses space expensively, and I rank it ninth on that basis while acknowledging it will still be running when most of this list has been hauled to the curb twice.

zh-tw.commentary:
2026 年買冰箱，關稅這件事的份量比廚房尺寸還重。美國商務部在 2025 年 6 月 23 日把冷凍冷藏櫃（HTSUS 8418.10.00）納入 Section 232 衍生產品清單，今年四月又改成對進口家電的完稅價格全額課 25%。六月一號到八月一號之間六家原廠陸續調價，ASKO 漲 10%，GE 和 Café 漲 7% 到 11%，LG 漲 6%，KitchenAid 漲 3.5% 到 6.5%，Whirlpool 四月先漲超過 10%、七月九號再補 4%，Bosch 和 Thermador 八月一號漲 8% 到 12%。光是五月，美國大型家電的 CPI 就跳了 4.3%，到七月為止年增 12.2%。這頁上每一個標價都已經含了這一輪。

所以我把 GE Profile PVD28BYNFS 放第一。27.9 立方英尺，定價 4,399 美元、實際成交 2,799 美元，換算下來不到九萬台幣就能買到接近 790 公升的容量，這個價位在台灣大概只能買到日系六百多公升的對開機。更關鍵的是 GE Appliances 正在花 30 億美元把冰箱產線從中國搬到阿拉巴馬廠，路易維爾總廠同時加人。工廠站在關稅牆內側的機器，下一輪公告落下來的時候能動的空間比較小。

老實說，另一條路線我也很認同，那就是 LG。Yale Appliance 統計了 33,190 通第一年報修電話，LG 的報修率 5.5%，全場最低。LF24Z6530S 給你 23.7 立方英尺的淺身機身，鉸鏈設計讓兩扇門在緊貼櫥櫃的狀態下還能整片打開，這對台灣常見的一字型小廚房特別有感，冰箱旁邊往往就是牆或電器櫃。定價 3,899 美元、現在 1,699 美元收得到。它是進口機，我把這個價格看成一扇會關上的窗。

講白了，這個品類的妥善率就看兩件事。法式對開門冰箱是 Yale 統計裡報修最多的類型之一，元凶在製冰系統，冰要從冷藏區這個相對溫暖的環境走一趟，於是漏水、水管結冰、出冰口堵塞輪流上演。第二件事，帶 Wi-Fi、觸控螢幕、App 整合的機型，報修率會比同品牌旁邊那台陽春款高 10% 到 20%。我把這件事直接寫進評分裡，所以配了 Family Hub+ 大螢幕、硬體規格全場最強的 Samsung Bespoke，在這份榜單上排第十。

還有一個時間點你要記著。美國能源部 2023 年 12 月 29 日定案的新標準會讓冰箱耗電再降大約 11%，依機型分別在 2029 或 2030 年 1 月 31 日生效。今年買下去的機器，接下來 12 到 15 年都跑今天這組數字。

highlights.title: GE Profile 拿第一的關鍵在那座站在關稅牆內側的工廠
highlights.body: GE Appliances 在 2025 年 8 月宣布 30 億美元的美國製造擴張案，把六款原本中國生產的冰箱移到阿拉巴馬廠，路易維爾總部園區加開 800 個職缺，產能分散在肯塔基、喬治亞、阿拉巴馬、田納西和南卡五個州。這就是我目前給最高權重的變數。PVD28BYNFS 除了這個底氣，硬體也撐得住，27.9 立方英尺、TwinChill 雙蒸發器讓冷藏的濕度和冷凍各走各的、門中門那格還有可旋轉的酒瓶架、AutoFill 感應接水。定價 4,399 美元、實際成交 2,799 美元，換算每立方英尺約 100 美元，而且這是一台供應鏈正被刻意搬回本土的機器。

highlights.title: LG 的 5.5% 首年報修率是這個品類裡最有參考價值的數字
highlights.body: Yale Appliance 用 33,190 通第一年報修電話算出各品牌的報修率，LG 的 5.5% 是全場最低，GE 和 GE Profile 以 8% 到 9.2% 緊跟在後。說真的，我一律相信實際派工資料勝過問卷分數，因為技師要嘛出車了要嘛沒出，這件事沒有模糊空間。大家最擔心的 LG 線性壓縮機，在超過 16 萬通追蹤紀錄裡五年內故障率約 1.1%。有這個底子，23.7 立方英尺的淺身機開 1,699 美元，就是這頁上單一 CP 值最猛的組合。

highlights.title: 法式對開門冰箱壞掉的地方幾乎都在製冰系統，所以我把它獨立拉出來評分
highlights.body: 法式對開門冰箱是 Yale 統計裡報修最多的類型之一，原因是結構性的，製冰和儲冰都放在相對溫暖的冷藏櫃裡面，進水管、製冰盒加熱片、出冰滑道全都待在融水有路可走的位置。接下來就是漏水、水管結冰、滑道堵塞這一套劇本。維修業界的資料顯示法式對開門的故障率大約是上冷凍機型的兩倍，帶外取飲水的機型平均壽命落在 9 到 12 年。所以這份榜單上每一台都有獨立的製冰與飲水分數，Whirlpool WRF555SDFZ 在這一欄拿的分數普通，它靠的是關稅風險那一欄站上名次。

highlights.title: Hisense 1,799 美元換到的每一分容量，是這頁最划算的
highlights.body: HRM260N6TSE 在四門格局裡塞了 25.6 立方英尺，VersaTemp 抽屜從冰酒溫度一路開到冷凍，360 度環繞 LED，ConnectLife App 控制，建議售價 2,899 美元、上市價 1,799 美元。獨立實驗室的測試給它的溫度穩定度評價相當高，而溫度穩定度剛好是便宜冰箱最容易漏氣的地方。代價是中國組裝的機身要吃滿 25% 稅率，加上美國本地的維修據點比較稀疏，這兩件事讓它停在第六名。

highlights.title: Sub-Zero 的 13,249 美元買的是十二年密封系統保固和威斯康辛製造
highlights.body: CL4250SD 用兩組獨立壓縮機分別跑冷藏和冷凍，所以冷凍那側不會把冷藏的濕度抽乾，空氣淨化匣每 20 分鐘清一次乙烯，密封系統保固十二年。Sub-Zero 在威斯康辛和亞利桑那生產，國產零件比例是業界最高的一群，所以它在關稅風險這欄拿 9.5，進口的高階對手大多落在 6 附近。42 吋的牆面寬度只換到 24 立方英尺，空間效率的代價很實在，我因此把它排在第九，同時我也承認這台會在榜上多數機器被搬去回收兩輪之後還在運轉。

references.title: IFA 2026: everything worth knowing about the world’s largest home and consumer electronics show
What to expect at IFA 2026: AI everywhere, robots, laptops evolved, smarter homes and more

en.commentary: Samsung expanded its Bespoke AI appliance line at IFA today with deeper generative capabilities across refrigerators, and LG showed new Signature appliances with automated diagnostics. Both use local neural processing to manage power consumption, and I am interested in the energy management specifically because that is where a refrigerator actually costs you money. A fridge runs continuously for fifteen years, and the difference between an efficient unit and an average one across that lifespan is substantial. The GE Profile PVD28BYNFS holds first at 8.9 and it wins on cold stability, which is the specification that determines whether food actually keeps. Temperature swings in a poorly regulated fridge shorten the life of everything inside it, and GE holds a tighter band than most. LG Counter-Depth MAX LF24Z6530S at 8.7 gives you more usable interior volume in the same external footprint, which matters in a Taiwanese kitchen where the cabinet opening is fixed. LG LRYXC2606S at 8.5 is the value pick. Bosch B36CL80ENS at 8.4 has the best build quality. Cafe CVE28DP2NS1 at 8.4 offers customisation. Practical guidance: measure your doorway and your kitchen turn before ordering. A refrigerator that cannot physically reach the kitchen is the most expensive delivery mistake in appliances, and it happens more often than you would expect.

highlights.title: Cold stability determines whether food keeps
highlights.body: Temperature swings in a poorly regulated fridge shorten the life of everything inside it. The GE Profile holds a tighter band than most, and that consistency matters more daily than any smart feature on the door.

highlights.title: Measure your doorway before ordering
highlights.body: A refrigerator that cannot physically reach the kitchen is the most expensive delivery mistake in appliances. Measure the door frame, the corridor turn and the cabinet opening, because it happens more often than people expect.

highlights.title: Counter-depth wins usable space in a fixed kitchen
highlights.body: The LG Counter-Depth MAX delivers more interior volume within the same external footprint. Where the cabinet opening is fixed, that geometry gives you capacity a deeper unit simply cannot fit into the space.

highlights.title: Energy use over fifteen years is the real cost
highlights.body: A refrigerator runs continuously for the whole of its life, so the gap between an efficient unit and an average one accumulates substantially. Compare annual consumption figures alongside the purchase price.

zh-tw.commentary:
Samsung 今天在 IFA 擴充 Bespoke AI 家電線，冰箱加入更深的生成式能力，LG 則展出具備自動診斷的新款 Signature 家電。兩家都用本地神經處理單元來管理耗電，而我對能源管理特別有興趣，因為那才是冰箱真正花你錢的地方。

一台冰箱會連續運轉十五年，高效機種和普通機種在這段壽命裡的差距非常可觀。

GE Profile PVD28BYNFS 守第一，8.9 分，它贏在低溫穩定度，而那正是決定食物保不保得住的規格。溫控不佳的冰箱溫度會來回擺盪，裡面每一樣東西的壽命都被縮短，而 GE 的溫度帶守得比多數家窄。

LG Counter-Depth MAX LF24Z6530S 的 8.7 在同樣的外部尺寸下給你更多可用內容積，台灣廚房的櫥櫃開口是固定的，這件事很實際。

LG LRYXC2606S 的 8.5 是性價比選擇。Bosch B36CL80ENS 的 8.4 做工最好。Cafe CVE28DP2NS1 的 8.4 提供客製化。

實務建議，下單前量門寬和廚房的轉彎。一台進不了廚房的冰箱，是家電裡最昂貴的配送失誤，而且發生的頻率比你以為的高。

highlights.title: 低溫穩定度決定食物保不保得住
highlights.body: 溫控不佳的冰箱溫度來回擺盪，裡面每一樣東西的壽命都被縮短。GE Profile 的溫度帶守得比多數家窄，這個一致性在日常的重要性勝過門上任何智慧功能。

highlights.title: 下單前先量門寬
highlights.body: 一台進不了廚房的冰箱，是家電裡最昂貴的配送失誤。門框、走廊轉角和櫥櫃開口都要量，因為這種事發生的頻率比大家以為的高。

highlights.title: 廚房尺寸固定時，薄型機贏可用空間
highlights.body: LG Counter-Depth MAX 在同樣外部尺寸下給你更多內容積。櫥櫃開口固定的情況下，這個幾何設計給你的容量，是深型機根本塞不進那個空間的。

highlights.title: 十五年的耗電才是真正的成本
highlights.body: 冰箱一輩子都在連續運轉，高效機種和普通機種的差距會一路累積。看年耗電量的數字，跟看售價一樣重要。
